title: Iris releases open-weight search agents and a reusable evaluation harness
friendlyTitle: Iris opens two AI search models for people to test
summary: AllSpark Research has published the 36-billion-parameter Iris-mini and 403-billion-parameter Iris-pro search agents as open weights. The accompanying release includes an agent harness, tool and context-management support, plus evaluations for four search and reasoning benchmarks; the team’s broader training pipeline is promised but not yet released.
friendlySummary: AllSpark Research released two open-weight models that can search the web and work through difficult questions. It also shared tools for running and testing them.
whyItMatters: Open weights and a harness let teams inspect, run and compare search-agent behaviour without relying entirely on a closed service. Reported benchmark leads still need independent replication, and the incomplete training release limits how fully outsiders can reproduce the models today.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can study and run the search agents themselves. The published scores should still be checked by independent testers, and not all training tools are available yet.
